a2-206.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Counter
a2-206.scenario: Péter has just come into the district post office. He has taken a queue ticket, and the display now calls his number to window three, where the clerk is waiting.
a2-206.prompt: Greet the clerk, say that you would like to post a letter abroad, and ask how much a stamp to Germany costs.
cues: Say you would like to post a letter abroad
Ask the price of a stamp to Germany
a2-206.target: Jó napot kívánok! Szeretnék feladni egy levelet külföldre. Mennyibe kerül a bélyeg Németországba?
a2-206.english: Good day! I would like to post a letter abroad. How much is a stamp to Germany?
a2-206.canDo: I can navigate a Hungarian post office, take a queue number, and interact politely at counter windows.

a2-207.title: Communicative Challenge: Registered Mail
a2-207.scenario: Péter has an important official letter. At window three the clerk asks him how he wants to send it.
a2-207.prompt: Tell the clerk that you would like to send this official letter registered and with a return receipt, and ask for a dispatch receipt.
cues: Say how you want to send the letter
a2-207.target: Ezt a hivatalos levelet ajánlottan és tértivevénnyel szeretném feladni. Kérek egy feladóvevényt.
a2-207.english: I would like to send this official letter registered and with a return receipt. I would like a dispatch receipt.
a2-207.canDo: I can post registered letters (ajánlott levél) and request return receipts (tértivevény).

a2-208.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Yellow Cheques
a2-208.scenario: Péter has two yellow cheques, one for the gas bill and one for the electricity bill. At the counter the clerk asks what he would like to pay.
a2-208.prompt: Say that you would like to pay in the two yellow cheques and ask whether you can pay by bank card.
cues: Say you want to pay in the two cheques
Ask if you can pay by bank card
a2-208.target: Két sárga csekket szeretnék befizetni. Bankkártyával fizethetek?
a2-208.english: I would like to pay in two yellow cheques. Can I pay by bank card?
a2-208.canDo: I can pay utility bills using the iconic Hungarian yellow cheque (sárga csekk).

a2-209.title: Communicative Challenge: The Parcel Locker
a2-209.scenario: Péter got an SMS with an opening code for the parcel locker on the corner, but he has never used one. At the post office he asks the clerk for help.
a2-209.prompt: Tell the clerk that you got an SMS with the opening code and ask how pickup at the parcel locker works.
cues: Say you got an SMS with the opening code
a2-209.target: Kaptam egy SMS-t a nyitókóddal. Hogy működik az átvétel a csomagautomatánál?
a2-209.english: I got an SMS with the opening code. How does the pickup at the parcel locker work?
a2-209.canDo: I can collect and send packages using modern Hungarian parcel lockers (Foxpost, MPL, GLS).

a2-210.title: Communicative Challenge: The Collection Notice
a2-210.scenario: The postman left a notice in Péter's mailbox because he was not at home. Péter goes to the post office, and the clerk asks why he has come.
a2-210.prompt: Say that the postman left a notice in your mailbox, and tell the clerk that here are the notice and your identity card.
cues: Say the postman left a notice in your mailbox
Say here are the notice and your identity card
a2-210.target: A postás értesítőt hagyott a postaládámban. Itt van az értesítő és a személyi igazolványom.
a2-210.english: The postman left a notice in my mailbox. Here are the notice and my identity card.
a2-210.canDo: I can collect parcels and registered letters using official collection notices (értesítő) and ID verification.

a2-210-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Letter and Cheque
a2-210-consolidation.scenario: Péter is at the post office with an official letter and a yellow cheque. The clerk at window three asks what he would like to do.
a2-210-consolidation.prompt: Say that you are sending an official letter and want to send it registered, and ask whether you can pay the cheque by card.
cues: Say you are sending an official letter
Ask if you can pay the cheque by card
a2-210-consolidation.target: Hivatalos levelet küldök, ezért ajánlottan adom fel. Lehet bankkártyával fizetni a csekket?
a2-210-consolidation.english: I am sending an official letter, so I am posting it registered. Can I pay the cheque by card?
a2-210-consolidation.canDo: I can queue, send registered mail, pay a yellow cheque and collect a parcel at a Hungarian post office.
